expected_solc_divergence.reason: From '0.8.37' solc knows the `slotnum` built-in and warns that the name will be promoted to a Yul reserved identifier in the future (`Warning 5470`) while it is still unavailable. Slang models the name as either reserved or free, with no grace-period warning, so it stays silent. Neither side rejects the declaration, which is what this test asserts.
